Fourth GATHER: two inward-reaching curved strokes meeting a short central descending stem, NOT a bowl or magnet. Each should be unmistakably different in silhouette in monochrome, balanced weight, generous negative space and comfortable margins, no marks between columns. Sophisticated penned fantasy manuscript lettering, purposeful and readable as characters rather than ornate sigils. No Latin or Korean text, no digits, no tiny decorative pseudo-writing, no borders, no cards, no people, no objects, no stars, no pentagrams, no elemental illustrations, no gradients per character, no UI, no watermark. This is a visual alphabet family candidate sheet, not a functional diagram.
